comment: 49yo female, germline BRIP1 pathogenic variant confirmed on multi-gene panel ordered after maternal aunt diagnosed with high-grade serous ovarian cancer at age 64. No personal cancer. Childbearing complete (2 children, last delivery age 35). BRIP1 (BRCA1-interacting protein 1 / FANCJ) carriers: moderate-penetrance ovarian cancer (RR ~3.0; lifetime ~5-15%) — sufficient for NCCN-endorsed RRSO at completed childbearing or age 45-50. NCCN does not include BRIP1 in elevated breast tier. Fires RF-BRIP1-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: ovarian). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-BRIP1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (RRSO discussion at completed childbearing or age 45-50 per NCCN); alternative = IND-BRIP1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + symptom-driven workup, declining RRSO).
